name: Open Rummy
description: Open Rummy is an Indian partnership rummy game popular in Rajasthan and among Marwari families. Played with 3-4 standard decks plus printed jokers and sliding jokers (Twos). Players draw from an open discard pile (like 500 Rummy); only Aces and Threes can form equal-card groups. First team to 1,500 points wins.

content.text: Open Rummy is an Indian partnership rummy game popular in Rajasthan and among Marwari families. Played with 3-4 standard decks plus printed jokers and sliding jokers (Twos). Players draw from an open discard pile (like 500 Rummy); only Aces and Threes can form equal-card groups. First team to 1,500 points wins.

Open Rummy is popular in Rajasthan, especially Jhunjhunu District among Marwari families. The open discard pile from which multiple cards can be drawn is reminiscent of 500 Rummy, which was sometimes known in America as 'Pinochle Rummy'.
4 or 6 players in two teams; partners sit alternately (each player between two opponents). No peeking at partner's cards or communication.
3 or 4 standard decks plus printed jokers (peeniya/khabuchiya); all Twos are sliding jokers (duggi). Cards rank 3-A.

First dealer chosen randomly; deal rotates left. Dealer shuffles, opponent to dealer's right cuts. 45 cards each (4-player, 4-deck); 40 remain as closed pile. Top card turned face-up to start discard pile.

items.text: 3-Deck 4-Player: 31 cards each, 3 complete sets for show, no pure required, target 1,000.
